Add it anyway? Once the gateway comes online and reports, its devices are discovered automatically.

error.invalid_sn_format: Invalid serial number format: at least 10 alphanumeric characters required

error.broker_not_ready: MQTT broker not ready: an MQTT config entry exists, but its client is not connected yet. With the Huijian all-in-one add-on, confirm the add-on is running (built-in broker port 2022); with a broker you set up yourself, check its reachability and credentials. The connection is retried automatically - wait about a minute and try again.

mdns_name_conflict.title: Gateway auto-discovery is held by another Home Assistant (second Huijian add-on on this LAN)
mdns_name_conflict.description: mDNS broadcast registration failed on this host ({local_ip}): huijian.local is already claimed by another device on the LAN (owner: {owner}). LoRa gateways that discover through mDNS will only reach that HA, so this host never sees their reports. Two ways out: (1) stop the Huijian add-on on one of the two hosts - keep one per home; (2) point the gateway's MQTT server address at {local_ip}:2022, this host's broker keeps working. Restart the affected add-on afterwards so the status refreshes.

mqtt_channel_broken.title: Huijian gateway unreachable: HA's MQTT client is not on the built-in broker
mqtt_channel_broken.description: The gateway keeps reporting, but Home Assistant's MQTT client is not connected to the Huijian built-in broker (127.0.0.1:2022), so no gateway message arrives: bind requests (001) go unanswered (the firmware retransmits every 5 seconds without recovering), and no device or gateway card appears. Diagnostic code: {verdict}. Fix: open Settings - Devices & Services - MQTT and check the entry: address 127.0.0.1, port 2022, username ha_mqtt (default password huijian2022, matching the add-on configuration). To let Huijian rewrite the entry back to the built-in endpoint: restart the Huijian LoRa gateway add-on first (a restart rewrites the bootstrap marker), then come back and press Submit to retry one round. Huijian rechecks every 30 minutes and this card disappears by itself once the channel recovers.

confirm.title: Retry one channel check
confirm.description: The bootstrap runs one more round and HA's MQTT client is checked against the built-in broker (127.0.0.1:2022). Success closes this card; if it still fails the error is shown - verify the address and credentials of the entry under Settings - Devices & Services - MQTT.

error.still_broken: Still not fixed: the MQTT client is not connected to the built-in broker. Check that the entry points at 127.0.0.1:2022 with the same username and password as the add-on configuration; if another add-on owns that entry, change it back or remove it and retry.

mqtt_bootstrap_pending.title: Huijian MQTT auto-configuration incomplete
mqtt_bootstrap_pending.description: The Huijian add-on declared that HA's MQTT integration should use the built-in broker (127.0.0.1:2022), but has not succeeded yet - LoRa gateway reports cannot reach HA. The system retries automatically (from 5 minutes, exponential, capped at 1 hour); you can also press Submit to run one retry immediately. If it keeps failing: confirm the Huijian add-on is running and look for mqtt_bootstrap lines in the HA log to locate the cause (common: the MQTT entry is disabled, the original broker is still Supervisor-managed, credentials rejected).

confirm.title: Retry one MQTT auto-configuration
confirm.description: The bootstrap runs one more round: the built-in broker (127.0.0.1:2022) is configured as HA's MQTT integration. Success closes this card; if it still fails you stay on this page and the error is shown - confirm the Huijian add-on is running and the built-in broker is not taken by another MQTT entry.

error.still_broken: Still not fixed: the bootstrap has not landed. Confirm the Huijian add-on is started (built-in broker 127.0.0.1:2022 reachable); restart the add-on if needed and press again.

data.ws_gateway_enabled: Allow the Huijian miniprogram to connect directly over the LAN (listens on ws://0.0.0.0:port/ws)
data.ws_gateway_port: Miniprogram WS gateway port (default 9001; the miniprogram and firmware always dial 9001, so changing this breaks LAN direct access)
data.ws_gateway_token: Miniprogram handshake token (8-62 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-]; empty = no authentication)
data.expose_cover_as_curtain: Expose window openers as curtains (only use this when bridging to third-party ecosystems like vivo HomeBridge, whose device enumeration only accepts the curtain class; after saving, the entry auto-reloads and takes effect in seconds)
